title: Visual identity
slide_intent: Introduce identity as a combination of reusable parts. A designer can preserve a family resemblance while adapting individual communications to different messages.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can give programs a common visual vocabulary before asking them to make local design choices.
demonstration: The second section divider repeats the large red field and pale arc. Its introduction names the mark, color and typography as elements used together.
practical_value: Turn to this section when choosing which visual elements a communication needs and how they relate.
